title: Unit version identity
responsibility: Fingerprints a unit’s manifest, owned source, contract and runtime independently so changes can be attributed to the affected part.

inputs.name: componentVersion.manifest
inputs.description: Unit manifest identifying its owned source and contract/runtime definitions.

inputs.name: componentVersion.files
inputs.description: Map from repository-relative source paths to content hashes; owned paths missing a nonempty hash are omitted.

outputs.name: componentVersion
outputs.description: Unit id, separate SHA-256 hashes for the canonical manifest, sorted owned paths and hashes, contract and runtime, plus the sorted owned file list used for the source hash.
